01 / Point of View · 2026

Machine-to-Machine
Marketing

What happens when the thing consuming marketing isn't a person?

The path from a brand to a human may increasingly pass through a machine.
01BRAND
→
02SIGNALS
→
03AI AGENT
→
04EVALUATION
→
05HUMAN

BRAND

The starting point remains familiar: a company creates products, services, positioning and information. But the next layer may not consume those signals the way a person does.

DISCOVERABILITY

Can machines find your brand, product, information and evidence?

EVIDENCE

Structured information may become more useful than persuasive copy.

PERSONALISATION

Machine-mediated discovery can evaluate relevance at enormous scale.

PRIVACY

More contextual data creates more useful recommendations and harder questions about surveillance.

ENVIRONMENT

Automation has infrastructure costs. More computation is not magically free.

ACCOUNTABILITY

When an AI recommends something, responsibility becomes less obvious.

M2M isn't about replacing human marketing.

It's about understanding the new layer between a human and a market.

01 / Appoctet · Jun 2023 – Jul 2024

From software vendor to product-development partner.

The challenge was not simply generating traffic. It was connecting acquisition, funnel, sales and product conversations into a more coherent growth system.

RoleMarketing Associate & Sales Operations Head
PeriodJun 2023 – Jul 2024
FocusAcquisition · Funnel · Sales operations
Problem

Not a traffic problem.

AppOctet worked across websites, apps, software, blockchain, IoT and integrations for SMEs and mid-sized businesses.

AcquisitionFunnelSalesProduct conversationsCoherent growth system
Strategy

Sell the solution, not the build.

Position the company around solving business and product problems rather than simply selling software development. Behind it, one funnel system.

LeadQualificationSalesDemoFollow-up
Execution

Marketing and sales, one system.

Acquisition

B2B lead generation · Meta advertising · Organic acquisition

Website & CRO

SEO audits · CRO · Website optimisation · Google Analytics

Research & testing

User research · Product testing

Sales operations

Sales demos · Funnel management · Sales operations

300+Qualified B2B leads

02 / StoreInsta

Turning a product into a GTM motion.

An e-commerce platform developed within AppOctet. I worked on its early positioning, pitch and go-to-market strategy.

ContextBuilt within AppOctet
AudienceIndian SMB / business audience
PartnerEasebuzz
Problem

A product is not a proposition.

The product needed a clearer reason for an Indian SMB and business audience to adopt it.

Strategy

Make adoption easier.

A more accessible e-commerce proposition, built around five ideas.

One-time plan / accessible pricingCustomisation optionalityCustomer supportGuided onboardingLower-friction adoption
Campaign concept

From offer to subscription.

Diwali offerDiscount7-day free trialOnboarding / orientationStore setupOngoing supportSubscription

The trial and onboarding structure is the proposed go-to-market campaign concept.

Lesson

GTM is a chain, not a launch.

A product does not become a market proposition merely because the product exists.

ProductPositioningOfferAcquisitionOnboardingSupportConversion
Result

Partnership.

EasebuzzSecured as a partner
~7–8Strategic collaboration discussions supported

Easebuzz is described in my CV as a ₹1,000 Cr valuation company.

Evidence

From the work.
